rows.grounds: lexical noun denoting a large number
past passive participle describing afflicted beings

items.question: Where are beings subjected to torment according to this teaching?
premises: The scope is specified as eighty-four thousands.
The locus consists of womb-diagrams or yonic mechanisms.
Beings within these loci are described as tormented.
items.inference: Beings suffer torment within the vast array of eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The subject of pīḍitāḥ is not explicitly stated in this verse and is inferred from context.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
